ZaneH/piano-trainer
https://github.com/ZaneH/piano-trainer
MIT, Copyright © 2022 Zane Helton

Upstream is a React + Tauri desktop app. It loads MIDI soundfonts from
a CDN via soundfont-player, talks to a keyboard over Web MIDI, and
persists settings in a native store. None of that ships here.

This port is a classic-script rewrite of the trainer loop: scales,
triads, seventh chords, circle of fifths, and a short quiz. Notes
play from oscillators in this tab (the CDN soundfont stays behind).
MIDI is optional if the browser offers it. Home-row keys play the
same notes as tapping the on-screen keyboard.

What was kept: major / natural-minor / melodic-minor scale shapes,
triads and sevenths built on scale degrees, fifths around the circle,
the quiz of keys and fifths.

What stays behind: React, Tauri, Sentry, i18n packs, and remote
soundfont files.
